links.comparator_used: Standard double reading by two radiologists without AI (AI as additional reader flagging no-recall cases for extra arbitration)
links.outcome: Cancer detection rate, sensitivity, recall rate and PPV across three prospective phases
links.effect: CDR increased by 1.6, 1.4 and 0.7 per 1,000 cases (13%, 10%, 5% relative) in the initial pilot, extended pilot and live use (all P<0.05); sensitivity rose by 10.3, 9.0 and 4.3 points; recall rate rose by 0.2, 0.2 and 0.3 points; PPV changed by +1.9, +1.3 and +0.1 points
links.tradeoff: Additional arbitration reads on AI-flagged cases (arbitration rate rose from 3.0% to 13.6%, 3.0% to 14.2%, and 3.3% to 10.8%), equating to 4-6% additional overall reading workload; 0.16-0.30% additional recalls; specificity fell by up to 0.2 points; live-use PPV of additional arbitration was only 22.9%
links.quote: The additional arbitration reviews resulted in six (initial pilot), 22 (extended pilot) and 48 (live use) additional recalled cases, increasing the recall rate by 0.16% (initial pilot), 0.23% (extended pilot) and 0.25% (live use), respectively.

design_hint: AI as additional reader with arbitration review, phased pilot-to-live rollout
